products.items.page.title: Products
products.items.page.description: App-owned product master: types, categories, export and packaging data, and the cost / internal / export price tiers — one catalogue for purchased and self-made goods.
products.items.list.empty: No products yet. Create a product type and a category, then add the first product.
products.items.list.searchPlaceholder: Search by SKU, name, or model
products.items.list.columns.name: Name
products.items.actions.deleteConfirmBody: The product disappears from lists and selectors. Issued contracts and invoices keep their own product snapshot.
products.items.form.notFound: This product was not found, or you have no access to it.
products.items.form.field.name: Name
products.items.form.field.brandHelp: Brand owner for a purchased line, our own brand for a self-made or commission-produced one; leave blank when there is none.
products.items.form.field.manufacturerMo: The model printed on the contract line: the brand owner's for a purchased line, the factory's or ours for a self-made one, e.g. W5C.
products.items.form.field.specSummaryHel: Specification printed on contracts and declarations, e.g. White / 1.5L / with filter
products.items.form.field.unitHelp: Options come from the unit dictionary the dictionary library maintains; add a unit there to offer a new one.
products.items.form.priceEmpty: No price rows yet. At least one tier is needed before a contract line can pick a price.
products.items.form.priceHint: Cost price = what we pay: the supplier's price for a purchased line, the production cost for a self-made or commission-produced one. Internal settlement price = what we charge the subsidiary; export price = what the subsidiary charges its customers.

products.types.page.title: Product types
products.types.page.description: Product families (purchased and self-made alike); a deactivated type disappears from the product form's selector.
products.types.list.columns.name: Name

products.categories.page.title: Product categories

products.variants.title: Variants / SKU
products.variants.description: The sellable units of this product. A code is unique inside the organization (soft-deleted SKUs keep theirs) and the default variant is what a stock receipt books against when nothing more specific is chosen.
products.variants.defaultHint: At most one SKU can be the default; leaving none selected is fine.
products.variants.field.name: Name
products.variants.error.duplicateCode: Code {code} is used by more than one SKU of this product
